name: race_loading_two_rows
description: Loading in a race (design 5.6): a 2v2 Tide Race party on a server (the lobby fake) starts, and the loading barrier lays its cards out in two rows, team A above and team B below, a gilt rule between them and a coverage row under each that counts its own team's Builders ('Team A covers', 'Team B covers'); no 'VS', no tips. The cards keep their states (a percentage, Checking, Ready) in seat order. Then the networked race plays on the match scene with both hollows built from its start (MATCH_CONFIG's race, the first build): my hollow the first, the party strip with my team first, the strip's rival line; and MATCH_END ends it on the race's results, one block per team.

steps.msg: two rows of cards: team A above, team B below
a gilt rule between the teams
a coverage row under each, counting its own team's Builders

steps.assert: node('/root/Session/LoadingScreen').find_child('CoversB', true, false).get_child(0).text == 'TEAM B COVERS' and node('/root/Session/LoadingScreen').find_child('CoverageRow', true, false).get_parent().get_child(0).text == 'TEAM A COVERS'

steps.msg: the mode, the map and its waves

steps.wait_until: node('/root/Session/LoadingScreen').card_lines() == ['Sascha Lamplighter Checking', 'Ben Bellfounder Checking', 'Ana Lookout 45%', 'Kim Beekeeper Connecting']

steps.assert: Game.is_race() and Game.sim.seats.size() == 4 and scene.hollows_shown() == 2 and Game.my_hollow() == 0 and Game.seat == 1
steps.msg: the networked race: both hollows, mine the first
the party strip: my team, then the rival's

steps.assert: node('ResultsTitle').text == 'YOU OUTRAN THE TIDE' and node('ResultsPanel').team_lines()[0].begins_with('Your crew ') and node('ResultsPanel').team_lines()[0].ends_with(': Sascha, Ben') and node('ResultsPanel').team_lines()[1].ends_with(': Ana, Kim')
steps.msg: the race's results: the server's outcome, one block per team
